subject: Next Steps: POC Environment Gate Review & Owner Assignments
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jay Park <jay@novaforge.io>, procurement@novaforge.io
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 28 May 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Next Steps: POC Environment Gate Review & Owner Assignments

Jay — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed owners so we can get your POC environment ready on your timeline. I attached a draft MAP for the POC environment milestone (MAP_draft_20270528.docx).

Key environment gating items we covered:
- VPC peering: requires your infra team to share the VPC ID and CIDR; Redwood needs a peering connection from our infra account.
- IP allowlists: we'll provide egress IP ranges for the endpoint; Novaforge needs to add to firewall rules.
- SSO / SAML: test IdP metadata + a service account; test users required for role mapping.
- Secrets / KMS: decide whether Novaforge KMS is used or Redwood-managed secrets; define rotation policy.

Proposed owner assignments (please confirm or modify):
- VPC peering: Alex Chung (infra@novaforge.io) — action: provide VPC ID + CIDR by 2027-06-04
- IP allowlists: Procurement / Network (procurement@novaforge.io) — action: confirm firewall window & contacts by 2027-06-07
- SSO / SAML: Novaforge IdP admin (Jay Park) + Marissa Cole (Redwood SE) — action: exchange SAML metadata and test plan by 2027-06-10
- Secrets / KMS: Novaforge security lead or decide Redwood-managed; Aditya Rao (Redwood) to draft options by 2027-06-08

Target close for POC environment setup: 2027-06-14 (so the engineering team can start the POC week of 2027-06-21). If that target works, we'll lock dates into the MAP and request signatures.

Next steps: please reply with confirmed owners for each line, any constraints (maintenance windows, IP processes), and whether procurement needs any additional paperwork. If helpful, I can schedule a 30-min tech sync with Marissa and your infra team — proposed times below.

Attachments: MAP_draft_20270528.docx (docx), MAP_v2_environment_appendix.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0198

Thanks Ben — appreciate the clear summary. A few quick notes from my side:
- Alex (infra@novaforge.io) will own VPC peering and can share the VPC ID + CIDR. Alex is out Monday but will send details by EOD Tue 2027-06-01.
- Procurement: we have a standard security questionnaire to share; procurement@novaforge.io will confirm whether they need extra paperwork.
- SSO: I can be the initial contact to exchange metadata but we'll need our IdP admin (cc'd).

Please do schedule the 30-min tech sync — Tue 2027-06-01 10:00–10:30 PT would work for us.

On KMS: we prefer to use our own KMS where possible; I'll have security confirm the required key policies. If Redwood has a recommended pattern for secrets management in dedicated POCs, Marissa can share that during the tech sync.

Jay

Adding SE notes and a short checklist so the tech sync is productive. I also updated the attached appendix (MAP_v2_environment_appendix.xlsx) with the test cases we'll run once the environment is live.

Redwood SE prep / ask list:
- VPC peering: we need the VPC ID, CIDR, and whether route propagation is enabled. If Novaforge wants asymmetric routing to avoid overlap we can propose NAT/bastion alternatives.
- IP allowlists: we'll publish the Redwood egress IP ranges and the expected port ranges (443 outbound, and ephemeral for callbacks if you enable webhooks).
- SSO/SAML: please send IdP metadata file and a test account with Admin or TestUser role. Our test plan includes SSO login, role mapping, and JIT provisioning checks.
- Secrets/KMS: if you use customer-managed KMS, we'll need an IAM role to decrypt secrets for the test nodes or pre-provision secrets via your secrets manager.

I'll join the Tue 2027-06-01 tech sync. Ben — I'll prepare a short runbook and a minimal set of commands for the engine team to verify connectivity during the meeting.

Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com

Attachment: MAP_v2_environment_appendix.xlsx (contains test cases & runbook snippet)
